protocol.checkpoint_selection: fixed final checkpoint per seed; no evaluation-based selection

evaluation_schedule.final_checkpoint_lock: All4 final file/tensor hashes locked before the first fresh physics call, including residual-off fresh baselines

protocol.factor: Walking correction reference alpha only; all inherited training settings retained
protocol.frame_recipe: theta_ref=wrap(theta_actual+alpha*wrap(theta_commanded-theta_actual));wrap=atan2(sin,cos);exact old endpoint recipes at0/1 preservefloatidentity; midpoint finalangle normalized
protocol.frame_scope: Selected blended frame rotates both heading/lateral error axes;gains remain1.5/1.0;origin and local measurement frame stayactualnode-start
protocol.observation: 61 features: current/prior skill, nominal command, body velocity, angular velocity, gravity, height, local task errors/remaining goal, elapsed/window flag, phase, previous action, ideal-path error, joint position/velocity

paired_initialization.episode_counts_not_forced_equal: Fixed decision budget is retained; all actual case exposures and interrupted tails are recorded

prospective_analysis.directions: Higher task/physical/strict success; lower absolute local/global lateral and heading, endpoint error, Turn translation norm, completion duration, tilt/falls; larger minimum height
prospective_analysis.fresh_denominators: 16 fresh cases per arm, four per family; report old26 only as seen regression
prospective_analysis.frozen_task_scores: Original nominal/physical success and original strict diagnostics remain separate; no new historical success gate
prospective_analysis.negative_findings: Keep failures, geometry tradeoffs, strict losses, reward/objective mismatch and unchanged/no-gain results
prospective_analysis.optimization_return: Training return is not held-out learning gain; differing episode composition remains visible
prospective_analysis.pareto: Describe same-frame metric tradeoffs and seed11/29 directions separately; no aggregate weighted score or new historical PASS threshold
prospective_analysis.recovery_null: Missing/null recovery remains unavailable evidence, never zero or success
prospective_analysis.strict_scope: Midpoint prior qualification was nominal only; its retained16m first8m strict failure is a mandatory regression diagnostic, not erased or added retroactively to the old gate
prospective_analysis.target_skill_metrics: For fresh pairs, use the second skill for family precision/time/stability; retain unchanged-prefix and whole-case evidence

residual.level: transition-conditioned command residual added to frozen deterministic controller

reward.dense: per0.1s: -4*local_heading_rad^2 -4*local_lateral_m^2 for walk; -2*remaining_turn_rad^2 for turn; -2*speed^2 for stop; all -0.1*tilt_rad^2 -0.05*action_energy -0.02*action_change_energy
reward.historical_envelopes: unchanged; reward is new training surrogate, not a replacement task gate
reward.terminal: +15 task success else -15; additional -50 physical failure; -10*sum(abs(local_heading_rad)+abs(walk_lateral_m))

protocol.same_frame_comparison: Each learned seed versus residual-off at its own alpha; never credit a cross-frame difference as PPO learning gain

transition_recovery_diagnostic.role: new diagnostic only, never a task-success envelope; null means no sustained tracking recovery observed within window
